name: fuaran
description: Add Fuaran to your app in one prompt: let users describe UI in natural language and have it render. Bundles the Fuaran MCP server (generate / validate / recipe / scaffold) and a skill that teaches the call → render → remember-the-tree integration playbook.

endpoint.title: Generation endpoint URL
endpoint.description: The Fuaran generation endpoint (or your same-origin proxy path). Leave blank to develop offline against the local mock (npx @fuaran-ui/mock).

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: Your paid access token for the endpoint. Stored in the OS keychain / credentials store, never in the repo.

provider_key.title: BYOK provider key
provider_key.description: Your bring-your-own-key provider key. Memory-only; stored securely, never committed.
